Soundness audited: 5-path lemma (new edge (a,b) creates C6 iff 5-path joins a,b) is correct for not-necessarily-induced C6; v1 exhaustive include/exclude with cardinality pruning is complete; v2 max-degree fixing N(0)={1..d} plus deg<=d cap is a valid labeled symmetry reduction, and d-range [ceil(2T/n),min(n-1,T)] is complete for these instances because T>n-1 so upper bound is n-1 (no truncation of feasible d); C6-forcing and degree-cap propagation are monotone-sound; branching is exhaustive. Lower-bound witnesses achieve claimed edge counts with certified C6-freedom. Limitations are stated honestly (exact only 7..10; 11..14 one-sided; replay by rerun, no per-node tree archive). No proof/experiment conflation: exactness rests on closed UNSAT runs, witness side on enumerative check.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively, not by timestamp/failed search. He 2020 (arXiv:2009.04590) proves ex(n,C2k)<=O(sqrt(k log k)) n^{1+1/k} — purely asymptotic, at n=7..10 implies only loose bounds in the hundreds, no exact values/witnesses/optimality logs. Furedi-Simonovits survey (arXiv:1306.5167) confirms even-cycle Turan as recognized frontier but publishes no small-n ex(n,C6) table. Gyori et al 2022 (arXiv:2208.02538) determines large-n generalized counts (K_{s,s} copies in C_{2s+2}-free graphs) and bipartite C_{2s} counts — disjoint large-n/generalized regime, does not imply small-n maxima. Mukherjee 2021 / Conlon 2020 give asymptotic/order-of-magnitude C6-free constructions, not exhaustive maxima. Backelin 2015 closes a different forbidden family (girth 5, n=40..49). No source publishes closed replayable ex(n,C6) values with extremal edge lists for n=7..10 (or 10..14). Values are not mechanically implied by asymptotic inequalities. Internal prior scan (20 validated + 20 failed SCOPE records) shows no overlapping C6 edge-branching census.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline — four consecutive exact hexagon Turan numbers ex(7..10,C6)=13,16,20,21 with explicit extremal C6-free edge lists and closed optimality certificates, plus certified lower-bound witnesses for n=11..14 — is an exact invariant of a natural object (C6-free graphs) motivated before computation (Bondy-Simonovits Theta(n^{4/3}), Bukh-Jiang/He constants, stability programs, Furedi-Simonovits frontier). Values were not known or mechanically implied by loose asymptotics; a future researcher calibrating upper-bound constants pre-asymptotics or seeding stability/extremal programs could reasonably need the precise maxima and reusable witnesses. This satisfies the exact-invariant clause: motivated object/invariant, unknown non-mechanical value, retrievable datum. It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. The incomplete surrounding census (n=11..14 reported one-sided after budgeted closure overran; scope shifted from admitted 10..14 to delivered 7..10) is described honestly and does not erase the independently valuable closed fragment. No general criterion, completed census, or already-used downstream theorem is demanded.
